notes: Three taḥwīl branches: «شعبة» ends the first; «جميعا عن الثوري» gives the Thawri to the second and third; «كلاهما عن منصور» is the shared tail.
«بمعنى حديث جرير» names another transmitter for the same saying and is a variant remark; it is not written as a route here. The wording remarks («باسم الله») are left out.
The Prophet is not in the chain; the Companion is not named in this text.
